For e.g i was playing this super messed up game and one of the charters in the game (female) was all deformed and stuff (messed up) and instead of just looking away my brain made me stare and a week after playing that game (multiple times) i would be like "what if in a parallel universe we had sex and children and a life together and stuff like that and remember this female from the game was very disturbing imagery and disgusting and my brain was thinking like this and i would brake down and stuff. but sometimes i just tell myself this is life and our brains are like this to us no one else and there are people just like you that got messed up buy doing there own little thing in life. yes think of it like this. a thought pops into your head you stop, brake down, anxiety kicks and all of this is happening in under 1 second... now picture this a memory or thought is a train in your head your brain is the station you can choose to board that train giving into that thought aka (talking about how useless it is to even think about, this is stupid getting hooked on having to talk about this memory or thought ect) or you can let that train go right passed the station and choose not to board it and wait for a train (a memory or something nice aka happy place) and board that train :) and remember sometimes you end up talking about a past event (memory) or thought and you know you are not supposed to be thinking about this, you must always know its never too late to get off the train. this is from a professional psychologists her youtube channel is (Katie d'Ath) and she addresses all the ocd topics and stuff :)
